# Current VINDEX3 facts

**Class: CURRENT — generated.** Run `python3 scripts/current_facts.py --write` from the repository root; CI runs `--check`. Do not edit this file.

These describe the source checkout, not the latest published binary. [Documentation policy](../documentation-policy.md) defines the authority boundary. [Machine-readable facts](current-facts.json) contain the source paths.

| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| vindex package version (not release availability) | `0.8.0` |
| Candidate specification version | `3.0-candidate` |
| V3_CURRENT_SCHEMA | `4` |
| GRAPH_SCHEMA | `6` |
| PLAN_SCHEMA | `6` |
| PLANNER_SEMANTICS_VERSION | `23` |
| DEFAULT_EXTRACTION_GENERATION | `V2` |

## vindex commands

`describe`, `diff`, `encode`, `export`, `inspect`, `layers`, `plan`, `precision`, `represent`, `representations`, `update`, `verify`.

## larql vindex3 commands

`consequence`, `encode`, `exec`, `inspect`, `observe`, `ops`, `plan`, `references`, `represent`, `sensitivity`, `verify`.

Inventories list explicit top-level subcommands; Clap's generated help command, flags and aliases are excluded. Binary unit tests compare these lists with the actual Clap command trees. Use each command's `--help` for arguments.

To export for a site, run `python3 scripts/current_facts.py --export /tmp/vindex3-facts.json`. The export adds the checkout commit, dirty flag and SHA-256 of each authority file. A consumer must retain that provenance and label dirty exports as local work. CI publishes a clean-checkout export as an artifact; no reference SHA is hand-maintained here.
